name.pt-BR: Comemoração de Todos os Fiéis Defuntos

prayerExcerpt.en-US: I am the Resurrection and the Life, says the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Eu sou a ressurreição e a vida, diz o Senhor.

meta.face: The angel: youthful and serene, a HEART-SHAPED face with a broad smooth brow tapering to a small pointed chin, wide-set grey-blue eyes, a fine straight nose, fair skin and short golden hair curling at the ears; a gentle, consoling smile. The soul being raised: a man of about seventy with a SQUARE face, a broad nose, deep smile-lines and short grey hair, clean-shaven, his face lit with relief. The widow: about forty, a LONG, narrow face with a high-bridged nose, dark brows and dark eyes lowered in prayer, dark hair under her shawl. The boy: about eight, a ROUND freckled face and tousled brown hair.
meta.basis: The card keeps both images the brief allows: the churchyard on the night of 2 November, with candles and flowers as the faithful still do, and above it an angel leading a soul out of purgatory, a common theme of Catholic altar paintings of the souls, painted here as consolation, not torment.
